title: `E0479`'s help for a write through `?->` suggests `if ($x !== null)`, an operator Novis does not have.
text: The lexer rejects `!==` and names `!=` instead (`crates/nvs-syntax/src/lexer.rs`), so the code the help suggests does not compile. `lang:expressions/and-the-ternary`'s example 05 prints the help, so its `.out` changes with the fix. It closes when the help suggests `!=`, with the example blessed again.
